title: Disposition of funds.
bodyText: From the revenues collected under this chapter each fiscal year, the sum representing the first $2,000,000 of such revenues shall be deposited with the director of finance to the credit of the compliance resolution fund as established pursuant to section 26-9(o) before tax credits are realized. Any revenues collected under this chapter in excess of $2,000,000 at the close of any fiscal year shall be deposited into the general fund.

annotations.heading: Note
annotations.text: The 2022 amendment applies to taxable years beginning after December 31, 2021. L 2022, c 72, §4.

bodyHtml:
§241-7  Disposition of funds.  From the revenues collected under this chapter each fiscal year, the sum representing the first $2,000,000 of such revenues shall be deposited with the director of finance to the credit of the compliance resolution fund as established pursuant to section 26-9(o) before tax credits are realized.  Any revenues collected under this chapter in excess of $2,000,000 at the close of any fiscal year shall be deposited into the general fund. [L Sp 1957, c 1, pt of §10(a); Supp, §127-7; HRS §241-7; am L 1999, c 182, §1; am L 2001, c 28, §1; am L 2022, c 72, §2]

 

Note

 

  The 2022 amendment applies to taxable years beginning after December 31, 2021.  L 2022, c 72, §4.
